Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
> Which sets us up nicely for the question: what is the largest amount
> of bleed reduction that can be achieved during 1 bleed?

> (Contingency planning+telepathic counter...)

Contingency Planning doesn't actually reduce the bleed, does it?
I thought it was one of those phrasings where you "ignore" the excess,
but keep reducing off of the initial amount.
(i.e. I bleed for 5, you Deflect, I play Contingency Planning, you play
TC at superior, it's still a bleed for 3 that resolves for 1)

But the maximum amount you can reduce a bleed, theoretically, is pretty
large, and dependent on how many minions you have.
Imagine a "perfect situation":
Greta Kircher is Clan Impersonated to a Ravnos (or other Independent).
You give her CHI and ser.
You are being bled by a younger Camarilla (or Sabbat) vampire.

Greta's ability : -1
Telepathic Counter at superior: -2
Ecstasy : -1
Banner of Neutrality : -1
Folderol : -1
Ignis Fatuus at superior : -1
Rewind Time at outferior : -1

So that's a total bleed reduction of -8, just from one minion, and
theoretically -7 from each other Independent CHI/AUS/ser/pre vampire
you might control.

Can you do better than -8 with a single minion?

> Sab), Protected Resources and a Telepathic Counter at superior can

Protected Resources + Telepathic Counter will not reduce a bleed
from 5 million to zero. It will reduce the bleed from 5 million to
4,999,998, and then you burn two pool for it.

And Gangrel De-Evolution already has reduced the bleed stat of a
vampire, and the question was about "during the action". Sure if
you give a Gangrel a permanent -1 bleed you might be able to count
it, but I still think that my earlier answer is the best you can do
with 'effects' during the bleed.

Messages.Author: Stelios
Messages.Body:
> Well, let's get into hypothetical silliness. Matthias can reduce a
> bleed by the same amount, with the proper disciplines, against Samat
> Ramal-Ra ( or any other Settite or Baali who happens to be Cam or
> Sab), Protected Resources and a Telepathic Counter at superior can
> reduce a bleed for 5 million to zero (technically yes, it is a bleed
> for 5 million that resolves for zero, but this is fun!),

No, it doesn't go that way. Protected Resources just limits your pool lose
due to a bleed to 2, but doesn't effectively reduce the bleed. So with PR if
you are being bled for 5 milions, if you play a TC you are still being bled
for 5 milions-2, but will only burn 2 pool. The bleeder may still be Archon
Investigated, or bounced to your prey. so your prey will have the loss of 5
milions.

It's much the same as for Flesh of Marble.

Stelios

tobiasop...@hotmail.com (Tobias) wrote:
>Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message

Methuselah A controls Constanza. Her prey is Methuselah B, and she
controls Greta and Sir Ralph Hamilton and a random Ventrue.

Assuming Constanza was the one bleeding, and that she has impersonated
a Follower of Set and has a Writ of Acceptance to maintain her
Camarillaness, and had played a Foreshadowing of Destruction at
superior (and Methuselah B has 8 pool).

Greta reduces the bleed as above. (-8)

Then Greta blocks Constanza and, with the appropriate skills and a
weather control, burns the following retainers and equipment
possessed by Constanza: J.S. Simmons (-1), Tasha Morgan (-1), a Laptop
(-1) with Canine Horde, and X Priestesses of Sekmet (-X).

Then, when Constanza plays Form of Mist to continue, Greta wakes and
deflects the bleed by Constanza (who also has Y Draughts of the Soul
and a Tier of Souls) to Methuselah C (-Y for the DoS and -1 for the
ToS and -1 for Sir Ralph) who has 12 pool (-3 for the Foreshadowing)
and no Ventrue (-2).

So Greta reduces the bleed by -(18+X+Y).

--

So, then, assume a 5 player table.
Add in 3 Kindred Restructures to the above deck, remove the Aus and Quietus
Masters, and make all the (now 76) "X+Y"s into Priestesses of Sekhmet.
Draught is less efficient for this case.

Other than the Constanza deck and the Greta deck, there are 3 other decks
at the table which consist of nothing but 90 Priestesses of Sekhmet.
(Are we getting silly yet?!)
The initial prey-predator relationship doesn't have Greta as Constanza's
prey.
After Constanza and Agaitas are both in play, Constanza equips Priestesses
until her prey's library is exhausted.
Calls a Kindred Restructure, moves on to the next guy, and does the same
thing.
Another Kindred Restructure, and she's drained 270 Priestesses from 3 players
who all refuse to attempt to Withdraw. (270 turns later, of course).
Another Kindred Restructure, and Greta's controller is now Constanza's
controller's prey.
By this time, Greta's equipped with everything she needs, and has a perfect
hand of 7 cards (deliberately keeping some cards in hand so that the deck
is pure Priestess).

Her deck now needs 4 fewer masters to be older than Constanza, but still can
only get rid of 3 of them because of the combos.

So her deck is:

2 Chimerstry Masters
1 Serpentis Master
2 Animalism Masters
1 Thaumaturgy Master
1 Dominate Master

1 Wake
1 Deflect
1 Canine Horde
1 Weather Control

and 79 Priestesses of Sekhmet, which are all that is left in the library.

By this time, Constanza's Methuselah has only played about 6 cards out
of her own deck. 3 of her own cards to get the ball rolling on the
pillaging of the Priestesses of Sekhmet with each prey, and 3 Restructures.
So she has plenty of cards left to replace with the 79 Priestesses of Sekhmet
from Greta's controller's deck.

So, over 500 turns later (Connie has to hunt occasionally), the bleed is now
reduced by Greta by 18+90+90+90+76+79 = a Grand Total of an effective 443
point bleed reduction by one minion in one action.

Heheheheheheh. Beat that! :)
:)

After the AI, there is no bleed at all, as opposed to a reduced
bleed. AI doesn't reduce the bleed. Likewise, blocking the
bleed doesn't reduce the bleed, even though no pool will be
lost.

If a bleed of 400 becomes a bleed of 1, then that bleed has been
reduced by 399, by the standard usage of "reduce".
